abstract: Looking at each measure, the groups differ in these ways. Overall, Brostamide lowers blood pressure control compared with Cardivel. Overall, Brostamide lowers systolic drop compared with Cardivel.
conclusion: To sum up, the comparison of the groups shows the following. Overall, Brostamide lowers blood pressure control compared with Cardivel. Overall, Brostamide lowers systolic drop compared with Cardivel.
section:
### Additional comparison

Brostamide is a water tablet that helps the body clear extra salt. Cardivel is a tablet that slows the heart so it pushes with less force. The groups in this comparison were followed at the Maplewood Cardiac Group.

Table 5. Results for each arm and measure, split by subset.

| Subset | Arm | Measure | Count | Total |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| Older adults, Reduced kidney function, University hospital | Brostamide | Blood pressure control | 233 | 450 |
| Older adults, Reduced kidney function, University hospital | Cardivel | Blood pressure control | 303 | 450 |

| Subset | Arm | Measure | Mean | SD | n |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| Older adults, Reduced kidney function, University hospital | Brostamide | Systolic drop | 8.0 | 4.0 | 450 |
| Older adults, Reduced kidney function, University hospital | Cardivel | Systolic drop | 10.5 | 5.2 | 450 |

Each group is reported in the same way for every measure.
